notes.title: Color By 1.1 REVAMP!
notes.notes:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/5b0zj1kc5qwh2sl/ColorByBanner800x400_3.png[/img]

What’s New in 1.1?

[list]
[*] [b]Revamped intro to intermediate levels:[/b] Virtually all new in the first half of the game!
[*] [b]Smoothed out difficulty progression:[/b] Teaches and inspires you to step into the harder puzzles!
[*] [b]Early Guidance Tips:[/b] Creates awareness of puzzles concepts!
[*] [b]Co-Op Game Mode:[/b] Play with a friend to solve special two-player puzzles!
[*] [b]Challenge Mode Puzzles:[/b] Beyond the hardest levels, these are for those who are not feint of heart!
[*] [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=705125675]Official Player’s Manual:[/url][/b] Provides the details of every aspect of the game including the lore of [i]Color By[/i] written by Tim Ahrens, author of the fantasy book [i]The Salvation of Tanlegalle[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: More fun and new challenges are right around the corner!
notes.notes:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/ckmzvine8bd7vad/ColorByBanner800x400_update2.png[/img]

There was an amazing turnout at the Let's Play Gaming Expo this past weekend. We'd like to thank everyone who stopped by our booth to check out [i]Color By[/i]! It was great to meet each and every one of you. 

We are just about ready to release the [b]1.1 revamp of [i]Color By[/i][/b]. Most of the first half of the game's levels are completely new and we’ve added good guidance early on so that you can understand what items are and how you can use them, and you can see hints toward solving the level. The difficulty progression has also been carefully smoothed out in order to step you into increasingly difficult puzzles. The biggest change we are making is the [b]introduction of two new game modes[/b]—separate from the Solo mission—available to everyone who has purchased or will purchase Color By for FREE as a core mode of the game, rather than as DLC. In addition to the now 130 solo levels, we are including an entire set of exclusively [b]Co-op[/b] only puzzles! And, for those who long for the ultimate challenges, we are introducing [b]Challenge[/b] mode puzzles. These puzzles are not for the feint of heart: They are feats of skill and dexterity as well as wit.

To accomplish this dramatic remaster of the game, we unfortunately need to [b]erase the progress on the Steam cloud[/b]—but we have in mind to make it up to you: Everyone that has already purchased a copy of Color By (and played it) before the update to version 1.1 will receive an [b]exclusive gift[/b]! (We'd love to hear what kind of gift you are interested in, for example a new head customization, legacy level pack, or desktop wallpaper image.) 


[b]Thank you for your continued support and encouragement.[/b]

-=Team Polykroma

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE: More fun and new challenges!
notes.notes:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/9isv2ndt1bmvvx4/ColorByBanner800x400_2.png[/img]
We’re creating an update for [i]Color By[/i] to add even more fun and challenges for you! Our new version will have:
•	Overhauled guidance of gameplay/mechanics and new reference guide
•	Earlier introduction of key mechanics
•	Reworked level progression with polished/rearranged/replaced levels
•	More puzzles using interlocked, revised mechanics
•	Co-op DLC

MEET THE [i]COLOR BY[/i] CREATORS
Stop by our booth at the [url=https://www.letsplaygamingexpo.com/] Let’s Play Gaming Expo[/url] in Plano, Texas -- June 18-19, 2016 

ADD TO WISHLIST
Add [i]Color By[/i] to your wishlist so that you’ll receive all our upcoming special announcements!
